LESSON: WORD CLASS: NOUNS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3.1: Word Class: Nouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Word Class: Nouns. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: which occur as same in both singular and plural in sentences. 1. Why is it important to use words correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural from given sentences
2. use nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural to make sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WORD CLASS: NOUNS
This lesson teaches Word Class: Nouns for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural from given sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural to make sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Word Class: Nouns using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Word Class: Nouns above.
2. Explain Word Class: Nouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Word Class: Nouns.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Word Class: Nouns with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Word Class: Nouns important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which occur as same in both singular and plural in sentences. 1. Why is it important to use words correctly?
2. Which singular nouns end with letter -s?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural from given sentences
2. use nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural to make sentences
